// Fixture-only component data seeding for bounded erasure tests.
export const fixtureSeed = mutation({args:{userId:v.string(), accounts:v.number(), tokens:v.number()},returns:v.null(),handler:async(ctx,a)=>{let accountId;for(let i=0;i<a.accounts;i++) accountId=await ctx.db.insert("accounts",{provider:"fixture",providerAccountId:`${a.userId}-${i}`,userId:a.userId}); if(a.tokens){if(!accountId) throw new Error("account required");const sessionId=await ctx.db.insert("sessions",{userId:a.userId,accountId});for(let i=0;i<a.tokens;i++) await ctx.db.insert("refreshTokens",{sessionId,state:"issued",hash:`${a.userId}-${i}`});}return null;}});
export const fixtureOrphan = mutation({args:{userId:v.string()},returns:v.string(),handler:async(ctx,{userId})=>{const account=await ctx.db.insert("accounts",{provider:"orphan-fixture",providerAccountId:userId,userId}); const sessionId=await ctx.db.insert("sessions",{userId,accountId:account});const hash=`orphan-${userId}`;await ctx.db.insert("refreshTokens",{sessionId,hash,state:"issued"});await ctx.db.delete("sessions",sessionId);return hash;}});
export const fixtureOrphanExists = query({args:{hash:v.string()},returns:v.boolean(),handler:async(ctx,{hash})=>!!(await ctx.db.query("refreshTokens").withIndex("by_hash",q=>q.eq("hash",hash)).first())});
export const fixtureDeleteSession = mutation({args:{userId:v.string()},returns:v.object({receiptRecorded:v.boolean()}),handler:async(ctx,{userId})=>{const account=await ctx.db.insert("accounts",{provider:"receipt-fixture",providerAccountId:userId,userId});const sessionId=await ctx.db.insert("sessions",{userId,accountId:account});await ctx.db.insert("refreshTokens",{sessionId,state:"issued",hash:`receipt-${userId}`});await deleteSession(ctx,sessionId);const receipt=await ctx.db.query("sessionCleanupReceipts").withIndex("by_session",q=>q.eq("sessionId",sessionId)).unique();return {receiptRecorded:receipt?.userId===userId};}});
